quotes.author: Kenneth Doohan
quotes.text: I would highly recommend, very knowledgeable about the area and fishing overall. I will be setting up another trip on a future vacation.
Captain Justin gave our family an incredible day on the water. He was patient, attentive, and made fishing easy and enjoyable for our kids, ages 10 and 12.
If you’re considering an Orlando bass fishing charter, this trip is well worth it. We caught more than 30 bass throughout the day with steady action from start to finish.
I just got finished with a wonderful bass fishing trip with Captain Justin. My grandson turned 11 and I got this for his birthday because he always longed to catch fish and be a fisherman.
My name is Louis Carr, my kids and I came from Cajun Country Baton Rouge, La to fish.

What a morning! Thank you so much for our trip this morning Justin - what a great time me and my boys had fishing with you on your fantastic boat. You literally helped them every step of the way and there wasn’t a minute when they didn’t have a freshly prepared rod ready to go 👍 Can’t thank you enough and we will definitely be back! This is the man to get your fishing charters with - polite, well informed and a great experience provider.

Justin is the MAN!! He knows the lake like the back of his hand. I’ve never caught so many fish in 1 outing.I felt 100% safe with Justin. He’s very knowledgeable, patient, and polite. You won’t regret booking with Justin.

I booked this trip as a birthday gift for my nephew, and it couldn’t have gone any better! There were four of us total, and the boat was super comfortable for everyone. Justin was an excellent guide—friendly, patient, and really knew where to find the fish. He took us to a few great spots, and we caught a ton of bass! You could tell he genuinely enjoys what he does and wanted us to have a great experience. We all had an incredible time and can’t wait to go again. Highly recommend Justin if you’re looking for a fun and successful day out on the water!
